Yeah - I have the chore/routine cards, and they are sexist. And not just a little sexist -- very, very sexist. Please review all images before you buy to make sure they align with your principles. 
Examples: the man-shaped characters are mowing the grass and washing their car, and the lady-shaped ones are doing laundry, cleaning the kitchen, washing their hair, etc. There is no place for this kind of gender bias in a routine chart, of all things. This is just ridiculous and disgusting.
Bonus points that they are also low-grade racist! There is a woman wearing a straw hat and pulling weeds in a flooded field under the "weeding" task card. Awful.
